title: UFOs denature nuclear weapons; Putin's test missile exploded in its silo
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of UFOs denature nuclear weapons; Putin's test missile exploded in its silo, about 1945-present at Russia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest on a podcast, Joe McMoneagle, says that ever since the first atomic bombs in 1945, UFOs have taken a huge interest in our nuclear weapons and have quietly disabled them so they will not go off. He adds that the last test missile Russia's president, Vladimir Putin, tried to launch blew up in its underground launch silo. If true, it would mean something non-human has been switching off the world's nuclear arsenals.
